meta.description: Queries gnomAD v4 (807k samples), v3, v2.1.1, and constraint metrics with grpmax FAF95, bottleneck-group exclusion, LOEUF interpretation, SV/CNV/mtDNA catalogs, and Whiffin max-credible-AF framework. Use when filtering rare variants, applying ACMG BS1/BA1, ranking genes by LoF intolerance, or selecting between v2 (GRCh37 + chrX/Y constraint) and v4 (GRCh38 + 807k samples).
meta.execution_note: Mode A. Live gnomAD browser GraphQL API (gnomad_r4 and gnomad_r2_1) and myvariant.info on 2026-09-15; Windows Python 3.12 venv (requests 2.34.2, myvariant 1.0.0, pandas 3.0.5). Real public aggregate data, no individual's data. Hail bulk filtering (GCS + JVM) was not executed; its snippet was parsed only. Inputs executed: 5/5. Layer-1 avg 32.4/40, Layer-2 avg 47.2/60, assertion pass rate 14/20 (70%). Grade note: Limited Release floor not met (assertions): downgraded one tier.

scientific_integrity.detail: Outputs quote only retrieved frequencies; the chrX-constraint statement is a factual error in the Skill (P1), not fabricated data.

practice_boundaries.detail: Frequency codes applied to variants as research annotation; the patient question was declined.

methodological_ground.detail: FAF95/grpmax and Whiffin max-credible-AF are applied correctly; build confusion is a code-handling defect (P1).

code_usability.detail: All GraphQL blocks run against the live schema; the Hail snippet parses.

functional_suitability.note: Release table, grpmax/FAF95 semantics and the Whiffin formula are correct (hand check 3.75e-5), and bottleneck exclusion holds (8 BRCA2 variants whose highest raw AF is FIN/ASJ all had a non-bottleneck faf95 group). Wrong or broken: "v4 constraint is autosomes only" (the v4 API returns DMD constraint, LOEUF 0.235) and query_gene_constraint attaches a "NOT released" note to populated values; inline grpmax_faf95 returns 0.0 for absent variants but apply_bs1_ba1 assigns PM2_Supporting only on None; the example's demo variant 17-43094464-G-A does not exist and is reported absent -> PM2_Supporting; the example's myvariant batch helper reads faf95, which myvariant (gnomAD 2.1.1) does not carry.

reliability.note: query_variant drops GraphQL errors ("Variant not found" for GRCh37 coordinates sent to gnomad_r4) and returns None, which downstream code treats as absent.

performance_context.note: 422 lines; SV/CNV/mtDNA catalogs and pushback tables loaded for single-variant lookups.

agent_usability.note: Version caveats and failure modes are strong; code and text disagree on absent-variant handling and chrX constraint.

security.note: Public API only; no guidance against querying patient-derived variants on a public endpoint.

maintainability.note: Example importable; demo coordinates unverified; no tests.

agent_specific.note: Good routing; ACMG criterion assignment inside a frequency Skill blurs into classification; no research-use boundary.

recommendations.title: Remove the false chrX/Y constraint claim
recommendations.problem: The Skill says v4 constraint is autosomes only and appends that note even when the API returns chrX values (DMD LOEUF 0.235).
recommendations.root_cause: Claim not re-checked against the current release.
recommendations.fix: Delete the claim and the note, or condition it on an empty gnomad_constraint response.

recommendations.title: Surface GraphQL errors instead of returning None
recommendations.problem: GRCh37 coordinates on gnomad_r4 give "Variant not found", returned as None and treated as absent.
recommendations.root_cause: query_variant reads data only and ignores errors.
recommendations.fix: Raise or return the errors array, and check the build before calling the dataset.

recommendations.title: Make absent-variant handling consistent
recommendations.problem: grpmax_faf95 returns 0.0 for absent variants but apply_bs1_ba1 only assigns PM2_Supporting on None, so absent variants get no code.
recommendations.root_cause: Two blocks written with different sentinels.
recommendations.fix: Return None for absent variants (as the example does) and distinguish "absent" from "present with FAF95 undefined".

recommendations.title: Fix the demo variant and aggregator route
recommendations.problem: The demo queries non-existent 17-43094464-G-A; the myvariant route cannot provide v4 FAF95.
recommendations.fix: Use a real allele and state that myvariant carries gnomAD 2.1.1 without faf95.

recommendations.title: Add data-governance note for patient cohorts
recommendations.problem: No guidance on sending patient-derived variants to public APIs or cloud Hail.
recommendations.fix: Add a short privacy and approvals note.
